purpose: Descriptive session transfer comparison independent of candidate evaluation. No refit or rescaling.

Run exactly one full native execution per arm per round with generous upper bounds (15,000 ms CPU; 30,000 ms wall; 256 MiB). Require Accepted from stdout, direct positive CPU ns with verified accounting, exact historical ELF/stdin/oracle digests. Compare all 6 historical samples with all 3 repeat samples per case; retain medians, ranges and new/old ratio, without exclusions or calibration.
